title: Pan-Fried Chicken with Marsala and Fennel
blurb: Tender chicken breasts cooked in a rich Marsala sauce with aromatic fennel and crushed fennel seeds.
steps: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then dust them lightly with flour on both sides.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 minutes on each side until golden. Remove and set aside.
Add the chopped fennel to the same pan and cook for 5 minutes until it begins to soften, stirring occasionally.
Add the garlic and crushed fennel seeds and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the Marsala wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add the chicken stock and return the chicken to the pan. Simmer gently for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper to taste before serving.
